events.text: A £4.50 paper statement fee dated 18 June 2025 has been applied to your account. This notification does not confirm whether the fee will be changed.
After completing H&V’s identification checks, I asked you to review the £4.50 paper statement fee dated 18 June 2025. I had chosen electronic statements, so I dispute how the tariff was applied.

summary: Mara Ellison, a verified caller, asked the desk to review a £4.50 paper statement fee dated 18 June 2025, saying she had chosen electronic statements and disputes how the tariff was applied. The desk registered the request with the documents team, and the case closed as requested. A separate documents lookup was refused, so her statement-delivery preference was not checked, and the record shows no change or refund of the fee, so the review and any check of her preference are left for the team.
